map.牙周袋深度与附着丧失评估器 使用指南: Periodontal Pocket Depth and Attachment Loss Evaluator User Guide
map.根据探诊深度(PD)与龈缘至釉牙骨质界(CEJ)距离，计算临床附着丧失(CAL): Computes clinical attachment loss (CAL) from the probing depth (PD) and the gingival margin to the CEJ distance to assess periodontitis severity.
map.牙周初诊多牙位探诊，工具由 PD 与 CEJ 距离算 CAL 并分级牙周炎。: At a periodontal first visit, probe multiple tooth positions; the tool computes CAL from PD and the CEJ distance and grades periodontitis.
map.疗效随访对比 CAL 变化，判断支持组织是否稳定。: Follow up on efficacy by comparing the change in CAL to judge whether the supporting tissue is stable.
map.种植周探诊同样方法评估边缘骨丧失。（结果仅供口腔健康科普与自我初筛参考，不替代口: At a later visit, probe the same way to assess marginal bone loss. (The results are for oral health education and self-screening reference only, and do not replace oral examinations, radiographic assessment such as periapical films or CBCT, or professional diagnosis and treatment by dentists, orthodontists or periodontists; if you have tooth pain, gum bleeding, ulcers that will not heal, abnormal oral mucosa or bite discomfort, seek care promptly at a proper hospital dental department.)
map.：输入：探诊深度 PD=7mm，龈缘至 CEJ 距离 = 2mm（龈退缩）\n计:
Input: probing depth PD = 7 mm, gingival margin to CEJ distance = 2 mm (recession)
Calculation: clinical attachment loss CAL = PD + recession = 7 + 2 = 9 mm
Explanation: CAL reflects the real loss of support and is steadier than PD; severe periodontitis is CAL >= 6 mm.

map.PD 和 CAL 区别？: What is the difference between PD and CAL?
map.PD 是龈沟底到龈缘的软组织深度，受牙龈肿胀/退缩影响；CAL 再加 CEJ 距: PD is the soft tissue depth from the pocket base to the gingival margin and is affected by swelling or recession; CAL adds the CEJ distance, reflecting the real loss of attachment support, so it is more reliable.
map.常按 CAL 与骨丧失：轻度 CAL 1~2mm、中度 3~4mm、重度 ≥6m: Usually based on CAL and bone loss: mild CAL 1-2 mm, moderate 3-4 mm, severe 6 mm or more, judged together with probing bleeding and tooth position.
map.出血、口臭是牙周炎吗？: Are bleeding and bad breath signs of periodontitis?
map.牙龈出血、红肿、口臭、牙齿松动是牙周炎常见表现；确诊与分期需牙周探诊与 X 线，: Gum bleeding, redness, bad breath and loose teeth are common signs of periodontitis; diagnosis and staging need periodontal probing and X-rays, so go to a periodontal department.
